caption: The drawing depicts a section of a wall with three large archways formed by columns, all of which are illustrated in light blue and white tones. At the center of the wall, underneath the middle arch, there is a wooden door with horizontal wooden panels and a metallic latch, colored in shades of light brown and beige. The floor consists of red rectangular tiles organized in a grid pattern. Along the bottom section of the wall, below the arches, there is decorative paneling featuring vertical blue strips and floral designs with green stems and small orange flowers. Above the arches, there is a horizontal decorative border, also adorned with stylized orange flowers and green leaves. The color palette is predominantly light blue, white, soft red, and orange, with green and brown accents.
title: Restoration Drawing
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
